description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between a numerical value on the x-axis and a value labeled “Missing Step” on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Missing Step” and has a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.844 to 0.860, with tick labels at intervals of 0.005. 

A dashed blue line, labeled “0-CoT”, begins at approximately (0, 0.859) and decreases to approximately (4, 0.844). A solid orange line, labeled “CoRe”, begins at approximately (0, 0.859) and decreases to approximately (3, 0.848), then increases to approximately (4, 0.848).
